title: バーで
situation: Sitting at a small bar on your own: ordering a drink, then talking with the person on the next stool.
register: Bartenders and neighbours often switch to casual Japanese with you (どこから来たの？). Stay polite: from a visitor it sounds friendly, not stiff.
The conversation usually starts with them, and nearly always with どちらから? Your About me lines are your opening move.
Asking one question back (お仕事は？, よく来ますか？) is what turns an exchange into a conversation.

vocab.note: Wait for it before your first sip when you're with others.
もう一杯 = one more. Also means "full" (いっぱい) in other contexts.
お酒 can mean any alcohol; 日本酒 is specifically rice sake.
Potential: 使える, "can use" (カードが使えますか).
早い (which you know) is early; 速い is fast. Same sound.
よく来ますか = Do you come here often?

dialogue.ja: いらっしゃいませ。お{一人|ひとり}ですか。
dialogue.en: Welcome. Just one?

dialogue.ja: はい、{一人|ひとり}です。
dialogue.en: Yes, just me.

dialogue.ja: {何|なに}にしますか。
dialogue.en: What'll you have?

dialogue.ja: えっと、おすすめは{何|なん}ですか。
dialogue.en: Um, what do you recommend?

dialogue.ja: このお{酒|さけ}がおすすめですよ。{九州|きゅうしゅう}のお{酒|さけ}です。
dialogue.en: I'd recommend this one. It's from Kyushu.

dialogue.ja: じゃあ、それをお{願|ねが}いします。
dialogue.en: Then I'll have that, please.

dialogue.ja: どちらからですか。
dialogue.en: Where are you from?
dialogue.note: Often from the person next to you, not the bartender.

dialogue.ja: アメリカのケンタッキーからです。ケンタッキーはバーボンが{有名|ゆうめい}です。
dialogue.en: Kentucky, in the US. Kentucky's famous for bourbon.

dialogue.ja: へえ、いいですね！{乾杯|かんぱい}しましょう。
dialogue.en: Oh, nice! Let's have a toast.

dialogue.ja: {乾杯|かんぱい}！
dialogue.en: Cheers!

phrases.note: The easiest way to start talking to the person next to you.

phrases.ja: もう{一杯|いっぱい}お{願|ねが}いします。
お{会計|かいけい}お{願|ねが}いします。
これは{日本語|にほんご}で{何|なん}ですか。
phrases.note: Pointing at a bottle works. People like teaching you the name.

dialogue.ja: すみません、この{席|せき}、{空|あ}いていますか。
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
dialogue.note: 空く + ている: it became free and is free now (Lesson 3).

dialogue.ja: ええ、どうぞ。
dialogue.en: Sure, go ahead.

dialogue.ja: {日本語|にほんご}、{話|はな}せるんですか。
dialogue.en: You speak Japanese?

dialogue.ja: {少|すこ}しだけ{話|はな}せます。でも、{速|はや}い{日本語|にほんご}はまだよく{分|わ}かりません。
dialogue.en: Just a little. But I still can't really follow fast Japanese.
dialogue.note: 分かる has no potential form: it already means "can understand" (Lesson 5).

dialogue.ja: いえいえ、{上手|じょうず}ですよ。{旅行|りょこう}ですか。
dialogue.en: Oh no, you're good. Are you here on holiday?

dialogue.ja: いいえ、{今|いま}、{仕事|しごと}で{日本|にほん}に{来|き}ています。{作曲家|さっきょくか}です。
dialogue.en: No, I'm here for work. I'm a composer.
dialogue.note: 来ています: I came and I'm still here (Lesson 3).

dialogue.ja: へえ、すごい！どんな{音楽|おんがく}ですか。
dialogue.en: Wow! What kind of music?

dialogue.ja: {現代音楽|げんだいおんがく}です。{今|いま}は{糸島|いとしま}で{新|あたら}しい{曲|きょく}を{書|か}いています。
dialogue.en: Contemporary classical. Right now I'm writing a new piece in Itoshima.

dialogue.ja: {糸島|いとしま}！{魚|さかな}がおいしいでしょう。
dialogue.en: Itoshima! The fish must be great.

dialogue.ja: そうなんですよ。やっぱり{魚|さかな}が{一番|いちばん}です。
dialogue.en: It really is. The fish is the best, no question.
dialogue.note: そうなんですよ agrees and invites more; やっぱり = "just as you'd expect."

dialogue.ja: お{酒|さけ}は{何|なに}が{好|す}きですか。
dialogue.en: What do you like to drink?

dialogue.ja: {私|わたし}はバーボンが{好|す}きです。ケンタッキー{出身|しゅっしん}ですから。
dialogue.en: I'm a bourbon person. I'm from Kentucky, after all.
dialogue.note: は for you (the topic), が for what you like (Lesson 1).

dialogue.ja: よくここに{来|き}ますか。
dialogue.en: Do you come here often?
dialogue.note: One question back keeps it going.

phrases.ja: {日本酒|にほんしゅ}は{少|すこ}し{飲|の}めます。
phrases.en: I can drink a little sake.
phrases.note: 飲む → 飲める (Lesson 5). The answer to 飲めますか?

phrases.ja: ここでカードが{使|つか}えますか。
phrases.en: Can I pay by card here?

phrases.ja: すみません、もう{少|すこ}しゆっくり{話|はな}してもらえますか。
phrases.en: Sorry, could you speak a bit more slowly?
phrases.note: 〜てもらえますか: "could I have you…", the softest everyday request. Learn it as a set phrase for now.

phrases.ja: {今日|きょう}はいい{夜|よる}ですね。
phrases.en: It's been a good night, hasn't it?
phrases.note: A warm way to wrap up before you leave.
